FEAT-6-S159.title: Consent Data Schema & Contracts
FEAT-6-S159.description: Define and implement data schemas for consent records including tier designation, timestamps, user/session linkage, and de-identification flags. Ensure Pydantic models and MongoDB schema alignment for persistence and validation.

FEAT-6-S160.title: Consent Workflow Integration with Lead Capture
FEAT-6-S160.description: Integrate ConsentService with LeadService to enforce tier-based consent requirements before storing identifiable user data. Ensure Tier 2 consent is required for lead persistence and Tier 1 enforces de-identified handling.

FEAT-6-S161.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
FEAT-6-S161.description: Implement unit and integration tests covering consent tier transitions, de-identification enforcement, API validation, and persistence behavior. Validate Safe Harbor compliance paths and failure cases.
FEAT-6-S161.evidence: GAP: No existing consent-specific test coverage found; tests must be created for consent workflow validation
